pr_title: Support corrupt PDF files with invalid/non-existent Group /CS entries (issue 11045)
pr_body:
The PDF file in question tries to reference a non-existent ColorSpace, which should be quite rare in practice.

Fixes #11045

issue_context.title: Cannot display figure in a pdf file generated with pdflatex
comments: @tamuratak @rubendsa Is it OK with you if we add the provided `from_pdftex.pdf` file as a regression test to our test suite?
It is OK. @rubendsa How about you?
Thank you both, also for reporting this. This is fixed by the pull request above.

> This is fixed by the pull request above.

Please also report it to the maintainer of the PDF generator as well, so that this is fixed properly, since the PDF file is actually corrupt (the `/CS` entry in the Group dictionary points to a non-existent object).

review_comments: Another possible solution would be use `try ... catch` instead, but given that similar bugs doesn't appear to be common that seems a bit unnecessary at the moment (also since it would probably be less efficient). In that case though, you'd probably only want to ignore errors if `this.options.ignoreErrors === true`.
